title: CION Adviser Deal: BC Partners Credit to Acquire 51% Stake
summary: BC Partners Credit agreed to acquire a 51% stake in CION Investment Management, adviser to CION. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - A fund advised by BC Partners Credit will acquire a 51% interest in CION Investment Management, adviser to[CION Investment Corporation](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cion/) (CION), under a definitive agreement announced Monday, November 16, 2026, according to[CION's official release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1534254/000110465926127745/tm2629786d1_ex99-1.htm) and[investor presentation](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1534254/000110465926127745/tm2629786d1_ex99-2.htm) . Closing is expected in the first half of 2027.

## What CION Investment Announced


CION Investments, which sponsors CION, and BC Partners Credit announced the agreement, under which the BC Partners Credit fund takes a majority controlling interest in CION Investment Management (CIM). The release describes BC Partners Credit as the $10 billion private credit platform of BC Partners, an approximately $40 billion assets under management alternative investment firm. CIM's existing members, including CION Investment Group and Apollo Investment Management, will retain 49%, according to the investor presentation.
